mn31:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
mn31:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.
mn31:3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo tenupasaṅkami.
mn31:3.2: addasā kho dāyapālo bhagavantaṃ dūratova gacchantaṃ
mn31:4.1: assosi kho āyasmā anuruddho dāyapālassa bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānassa
mn31:4.5: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañca nandiyaṃ āyasmantañca kimilaṃ etadavoca
mn31:4.6: abhikkamathāyasmanto abhikkamathāyasmanto satthā no bhagavā anuppattoti.
mn31:5.1: atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā
mn31:5.2: eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi eko āsanaṃ paññāpesi eko pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhapesi.
mn31:5.5: tepi kho āyasmanto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn31:5.6: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
mn31:5.7: kacci vo anuruddhā khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci piṇḍakena na kilamitthāti.
mn31:5.8: khamanīyaṃ bhagavā yāpanīyaṃ bhagavā na ca mayaṃ bhante piṇḍakena kilamimhāti.
mn31:6.1: kacci pana vo anuruddhā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti.
mn31:6.2: taggha mayaṃ bhante samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharāmāti.
mn31:6.3: yathākathaṃ pana tumhe anuruddhā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti.

mn31:7.10: nānā hi kho no bhante kāyā ekañca pana maññe cittanti.

mn31:9.3: idha pana bhante amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññāpeti pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhapeti avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhapeti
mn31:9.4: yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati sace hoti bhuttāvaseso sace ākaṅkhati bhuñjati no ce ākaṅkhati appaharite vā chaḍḍeti appāṇake vā udake opilāpeti
mn31:9.5: so āsanāni paṭisāmeti pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti avakkārapātiṃ paṭisāmeti bhattaggaṃ sammajjati
mn31:9.6: yo passati pānīyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojanīyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ so upaṭṭhapeti
mn31:9.7: sacāssa hoti avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghikena upaṭṭhapema na tveva mayaṃ bhante tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma
mn31:9.8: pañcāhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ bhante sabbarattikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma
mn31:9.9: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharāmāti.
mn31:10.2: atthi pana vo anuruddhā evaṃ appamattānaṃ ātāpīnaṃ pahitattānaṃ viharataṃ uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti.

mn31:10.5: ayaṃ kho no bhante amhākaṃ appamattānaṃ ātāpīnaṃ pahitattānaṃ viharataṃ uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti.

mn31:22.3: yasmāpi dīgha kulaparivaṭṭā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā so cepi kulaparivaṭṭo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassapassa kulaparivaṭṭassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.4: yasmāpi dīgha gāmā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā so cepi gāmo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassapassa gāmassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.5: yasmāpi dīgha nigamā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā so cepi nigamo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassapassa nigamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.6: yasmāpi dīgha nagarā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā tañcepi nagaraṃ ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittaṃ anussareyya tassapassa nagarassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.7: yasmāpi dīgha janapadā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā so cepi janapado ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassapassa janapadassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.8: sabbe cepi dīgha khattiyā ete tayo kulaputteṃ pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesaṃpassa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.11: sabbe cepi dīgha suddā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesaṃpassa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.12: sadevako cepi dīgha loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyya sadevakassapassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
mn31:22.13: passa dīgha yāvañcete tayo kulaputtā bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
